keyframes.framing: Medium shot: Tong Banh kneels in profile at frame right, head bowed, beside a scattered pile of disconnected lamellar armor plates and a fallen torn red command banner, against a ruined stone wall and bamboo.
keyframes.knownDefects: The asymmetrical single large shoulder guard is only weakly expressed (he wears heavy armor on both shoulders), and the armor reads as battlefield debris more than deliberately disconnected siege plates; otherwise matches the prompt at storyboard level.

keyframes.framing: Medium close shot: Tong Banh leans over bare flagstones and sets a square patterned command seal flat on the stone with his bare right hand, the removed arm guard lying on the stones beside him and his other hand still gloved.
keyframes.knownDefects: Framing drift — medium shot of the whole upper body instead of a tight detail close-up of hand, seal and glove; the command seal reads as a flat patterned plaque rather than a seal stamp and the removed piece reads as a vambrace, not a glove; character rendering is inconsistent with S01 (woven hat, dark cloak, teal armor here vs headband and bronze lamellar there).

keyframes.framing: Wide shot: a refugee group with bundles stands inside an open wooden gate at frame left while two unarmored men — a robed figure mid-ground and a conical-hat figure in the right foreground — stand apart from them across a fenced yard at dusk.
keyframes.knownDefects: Tong Banh is not identifiable — two unarmored candidates (robed man mid-ground; conical-hat man foreground right, an extra figure the prompt does not call for), neither matching his S01/S02 armor, so the intended foreground separation is ambiguous; the refugees stand inside the gate rather than clearly behind it in the background, and the palette shifts to dusk blue against the daylight of S01/S02.

notes: 3 separate 16:9 keyframes, one per shot, 640x360 each.
